international_results.use: Senior men's full-international score backbone; primary matched comparison is restricted to complete 1991-2023 rows.

team_strength.use: Year-end Elo ratings; a match in year Y receives the Y-1 rating to prevent look-ahead.

world_cup_history.use: Men's World Cup stage labels, scores, and regulation-time goal events through 2022.

fifa_2026_france_england_player_effort.coverage: All eight France matches and all eight England matches; 15 unique official FIFA PMSRs because match 103 is shared.
fifa_2026_france_england_player_effort.grain: One row per player-match in the player file and one row per focal team-match in the team file.
fifa_2026_france_england_player_effort.method: PyMuPDF table extraction of official player physical, in-possession distribution, offers/receptions, out-of-possession, and lineup-summary pages. Match-103 per-90 rates are compared with each eligible player's pooled earlier-tournament rate.
fifa_2026_france_england_player_effort.fetch_behavior: Saved official reports are read locally; missing reports are fetched in memory and are not persisted. Every processed row retains its report URL.
fifa_2026_france_england_player_effort.validation: Unique match-team-shirt keys; eight matches per focal team; player minutes reconcile eleven on-field slots in all 16 team-matches; parsed goals, attempts, and direct pressures reconcile official FIFA team-summary totals in all 48 comparisons.

minute_override.reason: Three goal events occupy the visible event slots in the PDF summary row, so the substitution time is not recoverable there.

fifa_2026_france_england_player_effort.known_limitations: Player observations share match-level tactics and score states. Physical totals include stoppage time while per-90 denominators use the regulation clock; the convention is applied consistently. The resulting player hypothesis tests are exploratory and Holm-adjusted across four related effort metrics.

fifa_report_format_reference.use: Format reference only; excluded from every analysis table and result.

fifa_2026_full_time_contact_discipline.coverage: All 103 completed FIFA World Cup 2026 matches through the bronze final; 103 match rows and 206 team rows.
fifa_2026_full_time_contact_discipline.asset_range: r12449-r12551; match numbers are parsed from the reports rather than inferred from asset order.
fifa_2026_full_time_contact_discipline.grain: One row per match and one row per team-match.
fifa_2026_full_time_contact_discipline.metrics: Fouls Against (used as fouls committed), fouls suffered, direct and indirect free kicks, penalties, offsides, yellow cards, second-yellow reds, direct reds, possession, attempts, and shots on target.
fifa_2026_full_time_contact_discipline.method: PyMuPDF extraction from official FIFA Full Time Match Reports. Reports are fetched in memory; compact processed CSVs retain the official URL and asset id.
fifa_2026_full_time_contact_discipline.validation: Matches 1-103 appear exactly once; every match has two team rows; fouls suffered reconcile to opponent fouls committed; goals reconcile 103/103 with the independent FIFA PMSR extract.
fifa_2026_full_time_contact_discipline.known_limitations: Aggregate reports do not timestamp every foul, so tactical fouls and score-state-specific contact cannot be isolated. Card counts also reflect referee thresholds; same-referee and foul-band checks are reported as sensitivity analyses.

lineups.source: Official FIFA PMSR team-summary pages for matches 101-103
lineups.method: Manual transcription of starting XIs; notebook checks exactly 11 starters per team-match.

individual_incentives.method: Timestamped before-versus-after mechanism audit: live award stake, player selection, match contribution, and change in the individual standing. This supports incentive plausibility but does not identify private motivation.
individual_incentives.known_gap: The Olise post-match assist total is reported by a secondary source because the saved FIFA PMSR does not assign assists.

charity_benchmark.use: Original Soccer Aid benchmark; descriptive external anchor only; never treated as a like-for-like professional control.

expanded_exhibition_benchmark.coverage: 26 additional matches from 2005-2026 across Corazon Classic Match, Match for Hope, Sidemen Charity Match, Football for Hope, Game4Ukraine, and Manchester United Legends v Pompey Legends; 41 matches after combining with 15 Soccer Aid matches.

source_tiers.official: Event organiser, governing association, club, charity regulator, or official news report.
source_tiers.secondary: Public event-history table used only for descriptive score context.

expanded_exhibition_benchmark.use: Expanded exhibition/charity context with event-level stratification and source-tier labels. It improves descriptive precision but is not a causal or like-for-like professional control.
expanded_exhibition_benchmark.inclusion_rule: Include a named charity, solidarity, legends, creator, or benefit event with a documented final regulation score. Penalty shootout outcomes are retained as metadata but shootout kicks are excluded from total-goal calculations.
expanded_exhibition_benchmark.known_limitations: The benchmark is intentionally heterogeneous: celebrity/creator teams, retired legends, and mixed active/former players differ in roster quality, rules, substitutions, and incentives. Corazon Classic Match 2010-2019 and Sidemen results rely on secondary public event-history pages; those rows are not used for high-confidence causal claims.
